# Babylon.js static distribution

Pinned version: **9.29.0**. License: Apache-2.0 (`LICENSE.md`).

- `babylon.js`: `babylonjs@9.29.0/babylon.js`
- `babylonjs.loaders.min.js`: `babylonjs-loaders@9.29.0/babylonjs.loaders.min.js`
- `LICENSE.md`: `babylonjs@9.29.0/license.md`

Downloaded from the versioned npm distributions through jsDelivr. Production loads these files locally on demand and does not request the CDN. Update core and loaders together, then run the 3D browser verification.

Loader API reference: [Babylon.js loading file types](https://github.com/BabylonJS/Documentation/blob/master/content/features/featuresDeepDive/importers/loadingFileTypes.md).
